description: A 2x2 sprite sheet of FOUR square top-down farmland ground tiles, each exactly 32x32 pixels, no gaps between them. Top left: untilled plot of packed brown earth, smooth with a few tiny pebbles. Top right: freshly tilled brown soil with three horizontal raised furrow rows and dark grooves between them. Bottom left: the same tilled soil freshly watered, darker wet brown furrows with a few small shiny water glints. Bottom right: green grass with a small wooden stake in the middle tied with a short rope, marking a plot for sale. Each tile fills its whole square edge to edge and tiles seamlessly with copies of itself (the three soil tiles also join each other). Flat straight-down view, same chunky pixel blocks, warm earthy palette and soft shading as the reference ground. No border frame, no text, no characters.

style_image.usage_description: Match the grass and dirt path colours and pixel style of this game ground.
